issues.detail:
"With Autocapture, Scribe turns work you have already performed into Scribes automatically. The procedure becomes a practical guide instead of a separate writing project.

The free Basic plan lets you generate how-to guides in the browser, so you can test one real procedure at no cost.": Taken as a sequence leading to the free-signup CTA, these passages can imply that the Autocapture workflow is available through the free Basic route. E12 establishes Autocapture generally and E1 separately establishes free browser guide generation, but neither citation establishes Autocapture as a Basic-plan entitlement.

The implied access route is free Basic signup, but the sequence may imply that Basic includes Autocapture. The supplied evidence establishes the capability and the free route separately, not that capability's entitlement on Basic.

With Autocapture, Scribe turns work you have already performed into Scribes automatically. The procedure becomes a practical guide instead of a separate writing project.

The free Basic plan lets you generate how-to guides in the browser, so you can test one real procedure at no cost.

decision.summary: All explicit product, browser, price, and desktop-plan assertions are supported. The unresolved issue is the offer as a whole: the Autocapture paragraph immediately precedes the free Basic invitation, which may imply that Autocapture is included in Basic even though that entitlement is not established.
